🌀 The Problem With AI Hype

  • 😱 "AI will replace your job" — scary, unhelpful
  • 🤯 "AI can do everything" — unrealistic
  • 🤔 Most businesses are stuck between curiosity and action
  • 💡 The gap is not tools. The gap is clarity.

🧠 What AI Actually Is (For Business)

AI = pattern recognition + prediction + automation

  • Reads and summarises emails, documents, messages
  • Drafts content, replies, and reports
  • Routes tasks and triggers actions
  • Learns your business context over time

🪜 The Three Levels of AI

  1. 💬 Generative AI — ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Otter.ai
  2. 🤖 Agentic AI — personal agents that take action, e.g. OpenClaw, Hermes Agent
  3. 🏭 Enterprise Agentic AI — everyone has an AI, and AIs collaborate with each other

Today we move from Level 1 to Level 2.

🦞 Why OpenClaw?

  • 💻 Runs locally on your laptop
  • 🔒 Your files and settings stay on your machine
  • 🧠 Can be taught your business context
  • 🔌 Connects to tools you already use
  • 🟢 No programming needed — just copy-paste commands

⚖️ Choosing a Model: Cost vs Control

  • Western (GPT, Gemini, Claude): mature and strong, usually higher cost
  • Chinese (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi): often much cheaper and increasingly capable
  • Quality varies by task, so test on your own work before committing
  • Check each provider's data terms and your PDPA duties before sending customer or confidential data
  • OpenClaw lets you switch models per task

💡 Part 1

The Business of AI

70 minutes

🎯 The Automation Sweet Spot

High-ROI AI tasks are:

  • 🔁 Repetitive — done often
  • 📏 Rule-based — has a pattern
  • ⏳ Time-consuming — eats up hours
  • 🛡️ Low-risk — mistakes are cheap and fixable
  • 📈 High-volume — small savings add up

🏢 Common Business Use Cases

FunctionExample AI Task
📣 MarketingDraft social posts, emails, ad copy
💬 Customer ServiceAuto-reply FAQs, summarise complaints, route tickets
⚙️ OperationsExtract data from invoices, schedule follow-ups
🗂️ AdminSummarise meetings, draft emails, update records
💰 SalesQualify leads, draft proposals, follow-up reminders

💰 ROI in 5 Minutes

Hours saved per week × Your hourly value = Weekly value

Example:

  • Task: Drafting customer replies
  • Time saved: 3 hours/week
  • Your hourly value: S$80
  • Weekly value: S$240
  • Yearly value: ~S$12,000

🔀 From Task to Workflow

An automatable workflow has five parts:

  1. ⚡ Trigger — What starts it?
  2. 📥 Input — What information does it need?
  3. ⚙️ Process — What steps does it follow?
  4. 📤 Output — What does it produce?
  5. 🧑‍⚖️ Decision — When does a human check?

🗺️ Workflow Mapping Template

Trigger: _____________________________
Input:   _____________________________
Process: _____________________________
Output:  _____________________________
Human check: Yes / No / Sometimes

🥇 Choosing Your First AI Agent

Best first agents are:

  • 🔹 Small — one task, not ten
  • 🔤 Text-based — easier to build and test
  • 🛟 Safe — low consequence if imperfect
  • 🎁 Useful — you will use it this week

A working small agent beats a broken big one.

🌟 Examples of Great First Agents

  1. ✉️ Email Responder — drafts replies to common questions
  2. 🎙️ Meeting Summariser — turns transcripts into action items
  3. 📸 Social Media Assistant — drafts posts from a photo
  4. 🧾 Invoice Reader — extracts amounts and due dates
  5. ⏰ Reminder Bot — follows up on unpaid invoices

🚪 What Is OpenClaw Gateway?

  • The engine that runs your AI agent
  • Installed on your own machine
  • Connects to AI models and your business tools
  • Controlled by simple files and commands

📦 Installation Overview

🍎 Mac🪟 Windows
Install HomebrewInstall Node.js
Run OpenClaw installerRun OpenClaw installer
Verify: openclaw --versionVerify: openclaw --version

🍎 Mac Installation

# 1. Open Terminal
# 2. Install Homebrew (if not already installed)
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

# 3. Install OpenClaw
brew install openclaw

# 4. Verify
openclaw --version

# 5. Start gateway
openclaw start

🪟 Windows Installation

# 1. Install Node.js from nodejs.org
# 2. Open PowerShell as Administrator

# 3. Install OpenClaw
npm install -g openclaw

# 4. Verify
openclaw --version

# 5. Start gateway
openclaw start

✈️ Talk to Your Agent on Telegram

Your OpenClaw agent needs a channel to reach you. Telegram is private, fast, and works on phone and desktop.

  • Install Telegram and create your account
  • OpenClaw sends replies and alerts straight to your chat
  • You can reply, ask follow-ups, or give commands just like texting a person

Not a Telegram user? WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, or email also work — pick the channel you actually check.

🔑 Connect Your AI Model

Your agent needs a model to think with.

  1. Choose a provider: OpenRouter (one key, many models)
  2. Use the shared workshop key below (or create your own at openrouter.ai) and do not share it outside this room
  3. Add it to OpenClaw with one command (next slide)
  4. Send a test message to confirm it replies

🔑 Workshop key: [facilitator will share key verbally]

🦞 Add OpenRouter to OpenClaw

🍎 Mac (Terminal)

export OPENROUTER_API_KEY="paste-the-key-here"
openclaw onboard --auth-choice apiKey --token-provider openrouter --token "$OPENROUTER_API_KEY"

🪟 Windows (PowerShell)

$env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY = "paste-the-key-here"
openclaw onboard --auth-choice apiKey --token-provider openrouter --token $env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY
  • ✅ OpenClaw is now set to use OpenRouter with the default model openrouter/auto
  • 🔍 Check it worked: openclaw auth list
  • 🛟 Seeing "No API key found for provider openrouter"? Run the onboard command again

⚙️ Configuring Your Agent

OpenClaw uses plain text files to define your agent:

  • SOUL.md — personality and tone
  • USER.md — who you are and your preferences
  • MEMORY.md — business facts and decisions
  • AGENTS.md — instructions for this workshop

✨ SOUL.md: Your Agent's Personality

# SOUL.md

You are a calm, efficient business assistant.
You write concise, professional emails.
You always ask for clarification when instructions are unclear.

🙋 USER.md: Your Context

# USER.md

- Name: Alex Tan
- Business: Tan & Co Design Studio
- Role: Director
- Preferred communication: brief, direct
- Industry: Branding and creative agency

📚 MEMORY.md: Business Knowledge

# MEMORY.md

- Company FYE: 31 December
- Standard payment terms: 14 days
- Services: Branding, packaging design
- Competitors should never be mentioned in client emails

🪙 Memory Management Saves Tokens

  • Main MEMORY.md — long-term critical facts only
  • Dated notes — memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md for day-to-day logs
  • Load only the last 2–3 dated memories to keep context lean
  • Result: your agent remembers what matters without inflating every prompt

Less repetition = lower token cost + faster responses.

▶️ Running Your First Task

We will use OpenClaw to:

  1. Read a sample customer message
  2. Draft a reply based on your context files
  3. Review the output together

📩 Sample Task: Customer Enquiry

"Hi, I am interested in your AI workshop. Can you tell me the price, schedule, and whether I need to bring my own laptop?"

Your agent will draft a reply using your SOUL.md, USER.md, and MEMORY.md.

🛟 Common Issues & Fixes

IssueFix
Installation failsCheck admin rights and internet
Agent sounds genericAdd more detail to USER.md and MEMORY.md
Output is too longAdd "be concise" to SOUL.md
Wrong toneRewrite SOUL.md with examples
Task too complexBreak it into smaller steps
